qoute: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken	- Oscar Wilde

	Tell me a joke: I will tell you a joke.

	Tell me a qoute: I will tell you a qoute.
	Change name to...: I will change my name to your suggestion.
	Hi/Other greetings: I will greet you back.
	Goodbye/Other farewells: I will farewell you back, and the chat will close.
